excluded_prior.holdout_policy: Training rows only; development and final-test splits remain untouched
excluded_prior.source: Original 12-image pilot, both 50-image calibration cohorts, and RunInfra 200-image trial

preprocessing_policy.alpha: composite on white after colour conversion

byte_budget.controlled_family: Use identical edge cap for parent and all three variants
byte_budget.method: Start edge1536; floor(edge*0.9) until every family PNG fits; minimum64
byte_budget.render_source: Always original source bytes, never a previously resized view
byte_budget.request_verification: Runner must verify exact serialized request bytes before any inference

preprocessing_policy.colour: embedded ICC to sRGB; missing ICC assumes sRGB
preprocessing_policy.encoding: RGB PNG with sRGB chunk; no EXIF

references: Fresh blinded assistant judgments on these exact delivered views; not human ground truth

selection_policy.method: SHA256 canonical JSON [seed, category, image_id], smallest first
selection_policy.near_duplicate_scope: All historical exclusions and all already selected new families; siblings allowed
selection_policy.source_parent: Megalith, single frame, no ICC or alpha; not presumed pristine

training_status: pending_human_review; every label task mask must remain false
